subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint - stewardship rotation and evaluation cadence
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nimbushealth.com>, Tom Beckett <t.beckett@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — proposed cadence & first agenda

Hi Alyssa / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, we'd like to stand up a short weekly MAP checkpoint to keep the evaluation plan on track and ensure procurement has visibility into the close timeline. Proposed cadence: 30 minutes, Thursdays at 10:00am PT starting Dec 9 (6 attendees max).

Draft agenda (first 4 meetings):
- 5m quick status (green/amber/red)
- 10m evaluation readout (progress vs test plan)
- 10m action items + owners
- 5m risks / exec asks

I've attached an updated MAP (Nimbus_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) and the current evaluation schedule (evaluation_schedule_v3.pdf). Please let me know:
1) Who from your side should be included as recurring attendees (we'll keep invites minimal)
2) Any conflicts with the proposed time zone (we can move to 11am PT if needed)
3) If procurement should be looped in from the first meeting or only at the contract stage

I'll follow up with a calendar invite (shared .ics).

Thanks,
Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Beckett <t.beckett@nimbushealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 19:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — proposed cadence & first agenda

Karthik —

Thanks for the materials and the clear agenda. Quick responses:
1) Recurring attendees from Nimbus: myself (evaluation lead), Tom (ops), and our SRE lead (Priya Rao) — I can add her once I confirm calendar availability.
2) The 10am PT slot works for us this week, but starting next week our director wants to join from 2pm ET onward. If you need exec-level attendance for a readout, we may request a swap to 11am PT for future sessions.
3) Procurement: please include them starting week 3 (we need to finish the 2-week POC before formal procurement conversations). For now, feel free to cc procurement@nimbushealth.com if you have docs.

One ask: can we reserve the second checkpoint to do a hands-on results review with our SRE and Redwood's integration owner? If so, can you assign an internal owner for technical follow-up items?

Appreciate it —
Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Director, Clinical Data Platforms
Nimbus Health

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nimbushealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — proposed cadence & first agenda

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks — Laura here from CS. Happy to own the technical coordination for the hands-on review. Rishi will take the integration backlog and I'll be the steward for infra validation.

Proposed internal owner assignments (to keep things clear):
- Integration follow-ups / test harness: Rishi Malhotra (rishi@redwood.com) — owner for fixes & logs
- Infra / deployment checklist: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.com) — owner for environment validation and runbook delivery
- Executive summary / weekly readout: Karthik Iyer — owner for cadence and timeline alignment

I'll draft a short runbook we can share in week 2. Also, Karthik — can you add the calendar invite and set the recurrence as weekly, but mark week 3 "procurement review" on the agenda?

Cheers,
Laura
--
Laura Bennett
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Folks — quick update: our SRE lead (Priya Rao) is available for week 2, but our Director will only be available for an exec readout on Dec 23 (would that conflict with Redwood team holidays?). We prefer 11am PT for ongoing cadence starting Dec 16 if that works for Redwood.

Also attaching our internal test-case matrix (sent separately). We want the week-2 session to be hands-on as requested.

Thanks,
Tom

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nimbushealth.com>, Tom Beckett <t.beckett@nimbushealth.com>

Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — stewardship rotation and evaluation cadence (final)

Thanks all — finalizing logistics below.

Updated recurring schedule: Thursdays, 11:00am PT (weekly), starting Dec 16. Invite sent (calendar-invite.ics).

Confirmed attendees (recurring):
- Nimbus: Alyssa Chen (evaluation lead), Tom Beckett (ops), Priya Rao (SRE)
- Redwood: Karthik Iyer (sales / exec readout), Laura Bennett (CS lead), Rishi Malhotra (integration), Monica Patel (solutions engineering — as-needed)

Week-by-week focus and owners (first 4 weeks):
- Week 1 (Dec 16) — Kickoff + baseline tests (owner: Laura Bennett)
  - Notes: validated basic model throughput; few infra config items logged (RISHI-INT-01)
  - Action items: Laura to circulate runbook (due Dec 18) — Laura Bennett
- Week 2 (Dec 23) — Hands-on results review + exec summary (owner: Rishi Malhotra)
  - Notes: hands-on session with Priya; director-level readout scheduled for Dec 23 (11am PT).
  - Action items: Rishi to deliver integration log bundle and remediation plan (due Dec 28) — Rishi Malhotra
- Week 3 (Dec 30) — Procurement alignment + contract timeline (owner: Karthik Iyer)
  - Notes: loop in procurement@nimbushealth.com; prepare pre-signed SOW draft.
  - Action items: Karthik to share SOW template and T&Cs (due Jan 4) — Karthik Iyer
- Week 4 (Jan 6) — Final validation gate and go/no-go (owner: Laura Bennett)
  - Notes: focus on pass/fail criteria from evaluation_schedule_v3.pdf
  - Action items: Nimbus to sign off on acceptance criteria (due Jan 8) — Alyssa Chen

Attachments included: Nimbus_MAP_v1.2.xlsx, evaluation_schedule_v3.pdf (also shared to HubSpot link above).

If there are any calendar conflicts, please ping me and we'll rotate stewardship (Laura can cover Dec 16 if I need to be out).

Cheers and happy holidays,
Karthik
